title: Parquet, ORC and partitioning: the two decisions that define the bill

videos.script: Two decisions are made when a file is written, and every query pays for them. {{two}} The first is the format. Rows, as in CSV, or columns, as in Parquet and ORC, and which codec squeezes them. {{format}} The second is the partitioning. Which column the keys are cut by, and how many files that leaves. {{partition}} In this lesson the same month of orders is written eight ways. Then each layout is asked the same question, and you count the bytes. {{eight}} You will see a file skip rows it never reads, because the rows were written in order. {{groups}} And you will see small files undo everything the column format won, in bytes and in requests. {{small}} At the end both decisions are priced together, at a thousand times this lake. The cheapest layout costs a fourteenth of the dearest. {{price}}
